record.question: One who depends on others.
record.explanation: Answer D: Parasite. A parasite depends on another organism or person for support; it is the closest option. Independent check: A parasite depends on another organism/person for support; the other options do not mean dependent. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/parasite. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
